agent_note: Prose fiction, not verse. First-person retrospective narrator of memoir cast, with an unusually strong narrating-moment present used for essayistic reflection rather than for reporting events -- which is why gnomic is large here (10 of 26) while every event quote is past. Not diary/dual: the present-tense material generalizes beyond the story world instead of describing the writing situation. Three quotes (q01051, q01052, q01053) sit on the boundary because a present-tense 'I think' frame wraps past recounting; all are called event/past on the recounted content.
